purpose: Document Kota Bharu's local land-registry custodian and bounded anonymous public-source/API checks without treating a geographically mismatched cadastral service, timeout, or access denial as citywide parcel absence.
assessment: Official PTJKB and PTG Kelantan sources evidence a local Kota Bharu land-office and state land custodian, with public land-administration entry points. The only public cadastral GIS metadata inspected describes Penang/Seberang Perai in a Cassini CRS; it is not accepted as Kota Bharu coverage. Its exact-WUP-point request timed out. No anonymous Kota Bharu parcel geometry or safe parcel identifier was verified.
registryAssessment: Local registry/land-administration custody evidenced by the official Pejabat Tanah dan Jajahan Kota Bharu and Pejabat Pengarah Tanah dan Galian Negeri Kelantan portals. This does not evidence an open registry database, title result, or public Kota Bharu parcel geometry API.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official PTJKB, PTG Kelantan, JUPEM public information, Kelantan land-revenue portal, and one public ArcGIS cadastral service.

attempts: Official PTJKB Malay page reviewed; it identifies the local office and public land services, but no parcel API was exposed.
Official PTG Kelantan portal fetched anonymously; it identifies the state land custodian in Kota Bharu and provides administrative content, not verified parcel geometry.
Official Kelantan land-revenue portal fetched anonymously; treated as a procedure/service entry point only, with no owner/title/account lookup attempted.
Official JUPEM corporate information reviewed; it describes cadastral/web-map responsibilities but did not yield an anonymous Kota Bharu geometry response in this attempt.

Public ArcGIS cadastral MapServer metadata fetched anonymously; it exposes Lot Sementara, Lot Kadaster 2018, and Lot Kadaster 2009 polygon layers, but the stated CRS and extent are Pulau Pinang/Seberang Perai.

Public ArcGIS layer schema fetched anonymously; only safe fields were inspected: OBJECTID, LOT, MUKIM, DAERAH, ADUN, PARLIMEN, DAERAH_ID, MUKIM_ID, SEKSYEN_ID, and UPI. No geometry or attributes were retained.
Exact immutable WUP point [6.11825961704686,102.262854032837] was submitted unchanged to the mismatched service; the request timed out after 20 seconds. This is not a citywide absence result.
Direct PTJKB homepage command-line request returned HTTP 403; no bypass was attempted. JUPEM cadastral route returned a TLS certificate verification failure; no certificate exception was used.
No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe owner/address/titleholder field, or personal/tax/account lookup was used.
